title: FX takes file (<workflow id>.takes.yaml)
description: The take each step path uses, written by `grida-fx reroll` and `grida-fx pick`; commit it. It has no discriminator: every top-level key is a step path, and `fx` is a legal step name.

propertyNames.description: A step path (identity.md §11): step names joined by `.`, each repeated step carrying its key in brackets and single quotes, with `\` and `'` inside the quotes escaped by a backslash: `entity['ada'].draw`, `entity['it\'s'].draw`.

take.description: The take the step uses. A step makes every take up to it, so it is at most 1000.

result.description: Written by `pick`: the file digest (identity.md §2) of the picked take's first output file, 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters with no prefix. A pick whose take no longer produces it is refused.
